newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Denmark grants Vietnam $10 mln for budget support.
newsitem.headline: Denmark grants Vietnam $10 mln for budget support.

text.p: Denmark agreed on Saturday to grant the government of Vietnam $10 million for budget support under a World Bank-assisted Structural Adjustment Project.

"With this grant, the Danish government wants to support the reform policy of Vietnam and at the same time ease the budget constraints, and in particular their effects on the social sectors," the Danish embassy in Hanoi said in a statenent.
The grant, which will be full disbursed this year, came ahead of a World Bank-chaired meeting of donor nations and agencies in Hanoi at the end of next week.
The donor community has become increasingly sympathetic to Vietnam in recent years because of its drive to reform the economy along market lines.
Official media have reported that Hanoi expects pledges worth $2.8 billion to be made at the meeting for 1997. But diplomats have said the figure was likely to be about the same as last year.
Aid commitments came to $2.31 billion last year, a rise from $1.9 billion in 1994 and $1.8 billion a year earlier.
